t: You're at Mile End Jewish Cemetery, which sits within the Novo Cemetery. Two notable people are buried here. Raphael Meldola was a rabbi, born in Livorno, who served in Britain and died in London in 1828. Moses da Costa, also known as Anthony da Costa, was an English banker. He died in 1747, which tells you how long this ground has been in use. Their burials here point to the history of the Jewish community in London.
